title: Geometric-point projection morphism agrees with the constant-section projection morphism
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field, $s=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, $Z$ any scheme and $h:Z\to s$ a morphism. Use ordinary derived tensor over $\mathbf Z$ [def-kun-derived-tensor] on the unbounded small etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $S_D$ and $C_s$ be the normalized monoidal geometric-stalk/constant equivalence [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-constants], and let $\beta:S_D Rh_*\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma_Z$ and $\gamma:h^{-1}C_s\xrightarrow{\sim}C_Z$ be the canonical comparisons [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-sections-adjunction]. For any $E\in D(Z_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf Z)$ and $M\in D(\mathbf Z)$, the following square commutes:
$$\begin{array}{ccc}
S_D(Rh_*E\otimes^L_{\mathbf Z}C_s M)&\xrightarrow{S_D(\mathrm{PF}_h(E,C_s M))}&S_D Rh_*(E\otimes^L_{\mathbf Z}h^{-1}C_s M)\\
\downarrow\alpha&&\downarrow\delta\\
R\Gamma_ZE\otimes^L_{\mathbf Z}M&\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PF}_{Z,\mathbf Z}(E,M)}&R\Gamma_Z(E\otimes^L_{\mathbf Z}C_Z M).
\end{array}$$
Here the upper projection morphism is [def-kun-projection-formula-map] and the lower one is [def-kun-constant-projection-morphism]. The left vertical isomorphism $\alpha$ is the monoidal comparison for $S_D$, followed by $\beta_E$ and inverse to $M\to S_D C_s M$. The right vertical isomorphism $\delta$ is $\beta_{E\otimes^L h^{-1}C_sM}$ followed by $R\Gamma_Z(1_E\otimes^L\gamma_M)$. This is an equality of canonical morphisms, with no assertion that either horizontal morphism is invertible and with no properness, boundedness or torsion assumption.

proof.text: Put $F=h^{-1}$, $H=Rh_*$, $S=S_D$, $K=C_s$, $L=C_Z$, $R=R\Gamma_Z$, and let $a:F\dashv H$, $b:L\dashv R$, $e:K\dashv S$ be the fixed adjunctions. With $\gamma:KF\simeq L$, put $\sigma_A=F(e_A)\circ\gamma_{SA}^{-1}:L(SA)\to FA$. By [lem-kun-geometric-point-pullback-tensor-normalization], $c^F_{A,B}\circ\sigma_{A\otimes B}=(\sigma_A\otimes\sigma_B)\circ c^L_{SA,SB}\circ L(c^S_{A,B})$. This concerns only pullback, constants and stalk evaluation; it contains neither a projection morphism nor a direct image.

proof.text: The first clause of [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-sections-adjunction] is the counit identity for the specified comparison $\beta:HS\simeq R$. Transport it through the canonical identifications of the exact termwise functors with their left derived functors. Naturality of these identifications and cancellation of $\gamma$ yield $\varepsilon^b_E\circ L(\beta_E)=\varepsilon^a_E\circ\sigma_{HE}$. This transport is proved in Lean by transport_counit; no arbitrary right-adjoint identification is substituted.

proof.text: Apply the existing categorical theorem CategoryTheory.Adjunction.rightAdjointProjectionMap_mate (WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.ProjectionMapCompat) to $a,b$, their tensor comparisons, the monoidal constraint of $S$, $\sigma$ and $\beta$. Its tensor hypothesis is step 1 and its counit hypothesis is step 2. The conclusion is the projection square evaluated at $E,K M$, with coefficient $S(KM)$ on the bottom and $\sigma_{KM}:L(S(KM))\to F(KM)$ on the target. The two projection maps are exactly those of [def-kun-projection-formula-map] and [def-kun-constant-projection-morphism].

proof.text: Naturality of $\gamma^{-1}$ and the left triangle identity for $e$ give $\gamma_M\circ\sigma_{KM}\circ L(u_M)=1$. Since the germ unit $u_M$ is invertible by [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-constants], $\gamma_M\circ\sigma_{KM}=L(u_M^{-1})$. Postcompose the equation of step 3 by $R(1_E\otimes\gamma_M)$. Naturality of the sections projection map for $u_M^{-1}$ and tensor interchange convert its right side to $\mathrm{PF}_{Z,\mathbf Z}(E,M)\circ(\beta_E\otimes1_M)\circ(1\otimes u_M^{-1})\circ c^S_{HE,KM}$. This is precisely the specified square, and no projection map has been inverted.
